parties:
Abdus Sattar & Others
Vs.
Abdul Gafur Sardar & Others
full_judgment: 13. A look at the Fourth Schedule to the Act will show that all these matters which have been mentioned in sub-sections (1) and (2) of section 133 have been made subject matters of appeal and appellate forum of various grades has been created by the Act itself in respect of those matters. Appeal is however not restricted to matters mentioned in sub-sections (1) and (2) of section 133. Right of appeal has been granted in respect of other matters as well in the Act itself and the Fourth Schedule contains a list of such appealable orders, by whom the appeal may be preferred, authority to which appeal lies and the period of limitation.
